name: the restaurant near Gladias's home
about: The neighborhood restaurant where Gladias runs into Febric in chapters 6 and 16 and passes its painted outer wall in chapter 11. The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: A robot slid up to him, and showed him a menu.
facts.fact: Robots take orders at the table.

facts.quote: Four others were sitting down, all beside the window to enjoy the view
A waiter handed Febric a tea in a cup with a sealed lid.
facts.fact: There is also a human waiter.

facts.quote: He passed by the same restaurant where he had bumped into Febric months earlier. On the restaurant's outer wall, he saw an advertisement.
facts.fact: Its outer wall carries a large painted advertisement.

facts.quote: the restaurant near his home where he would often stop for food and drinks
